metadata_selection: earliest64 per window by(header_available_raw_ns,header_callback_ordinal); original PCAP file order and timestamps unchanged; bounded two-pass SHADOW only
causal_validity: TCP availability and TLS header availability monotonic within direction; header event timestamp is max of all5 header bytes and required contiguous prefix; body delivery timestamp cannot move an already available header
cross_direction_packet_order: diagnostic only; never proof of stream-causal error
ambiguity: equal raw header-availability timestamp across directions
mask_application: delete inadmissible scores before joint group/actual-flow calibration or decision; raw scores diagnostic only
physical_claim: capture-time header adjacency is not plaintext request/reply causality; no timing-error bound inferred
